Have seconds passed? Hours?
After all that walking, I find a door that I figure is an exit.

Once I go through, I'll be back where I'm supposed to be.

#C236196003BB#CDEF, who had taken over the Moon, is gone.
#C236196003Kiara#CDEF, who had corrupted #C236196003BB#CDEF, is defeated.
